posts.title: [Updated October 2026] MDE Feature Comparison by OS
posts.description: I’ve updated my MDE Feature Comparison by OS again. The headline change since August is that Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is now available for Linux desktops in public preview. There are a few other additions worth calling out, particularly around Linux protection modes and WSL containers. Linux desktop support uses the same supported distributions, deployment methods, and security capabilities
